# viettelcloud_vpc_peering (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud VPC peering from the requester side. A peering with a VPC of another project, including a VPC shared into this project, stays `pending` until that project accepts it outside Terraform. Traffic flows only after each VPC has a route to the other VPC through the peering. Replacing or destroying a peering also deletes every route that uses it as the next hop.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_vpc" "app" {
  name   = "app-vpc"
  cidr   = "10.10.0.0/16"
  region = { name = "vn-central-1" }
}

resource "viettelcloud_vpc" "db" {
  name   = "db-vpc"
  cidr   = "10.20.0.0/16"
  region = { name = "vn-central-1" }
}

resource "viettelcloud_vpc_peering" "example" {
  requester_vpc = { id = viettelcloud_vpc.app.id }
  accepter_vpc  = { id = viettelcloud_vpc.db.id }
  description   = "App VPC to database VPC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `accepter_vpc` (Attributes) VPC that accepts the peering. It can belong to any project. Changing it replaces the peering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accepter_vpc))
- `requester_vpc` (Attributes) VPC that requests the peering. It must belong to the provider project. Changing it replaces the peering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requester_vpc))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the peering, at most 255 characters. Omitting it preserves the current value; set it to an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `accepter_project_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the project that owns the accepter VPC.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the peering was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) VPC peering ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Name assigned to the peering at creation.
- `status` (String) Peering status: `pending`, `active`, `rejected`, or `error`.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the peering was last updated (RFC3339).
- `vpc_peering_type` (String) `intra_region` when both VPCs are in one region, otherwise `inter_region`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a VPC peering by ID.
terraform import viettelcloud_vpc_peering.example 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
```
